use_case_name: Compare Two Files Byte by Byte

claims.content: To spot exactly what the different bytes are between two files and is not susceptible to collisions under any circumstance.

goal.raw_text: To spot exactly what the different bytes are between two files and is not susceptible to collisions under any circumstance.

claims.content: User
The user must have access to the file management tools provided by PeaZip.
The user must be in a state where they can select files, such as the file manager interface or an archive browsing view.
At least two files must be selected or available for the byte-to-byte comparison operation.
The user selects the byte-to-byte file comparison utility from the set of file management tools.

trigger.raw_text: The user selects the byte-to-byte file comparison utility from the set of file management tools.

claims.content: The user selects two files for comparison from the file manager interface, create archive window, or extraction window.
The user initiates the byte-to-byte file comparison function via the file management tools menu or shortcut.
The system performs a byte-by-byte comparison between the two selected files, spotting exactly what the different bytes are.
The system displays the differing bytes and their locations to the user.
The user has been presented with a detailed view of exactly what the different bytes are between the two compared files.

The comparison result is not susceptible to collisions under any circumstance, even if conditions are highly improbable and very difficult or not practically possible to trigger if a proper hash function is chosen.
